dataLicenses.name: NMRexp-derived ¹⁹F GNN model weights, training-domain counts and HOSE shift statistics
dataLicenses.attribution: Wang, Jun-Jie and Zhu, Rong, NMRexp (Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.17296666), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); dataset paper: Wang, J.-J., Jin, Y., Zhi, C.-Y. et al., Scientific Data 12, 1954 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41597-025-06245-5. Changes were made: the ¹⁹F rows were filtered (single fluorine environment, single peak), deduplicated, cleaned by an outlier rule and transformed into aggregated HOSE shift statistics and GNN model weights by ChemDraft; no structures are included. Not endorsed by the dataset authors. NMRShiftDB2 was used only as the test gate; it is not a source of the ¹⁹F model or table.

description: ChemDraft NMR shift predictor plugin: a bundled graph neural network trained on NMRShiftDB2 assignments predicts 1H/13C shifts, with HOSE-fragment statistics from NMRShiftDB2 as cross-check and fallback; 31P statistics from Ilm-NMR-P31 v3.0.
